title: PCSO’s Oct. 25 lotto results: P440.65M jackpot not won

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the P440.65 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the P66.73 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the winning combination for Ultra Lotto 6/58 was 38-48-55-57-05-50, which carried a jackpot prize of P440.65 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the winning combination 49-38-12-07-33-34, with a jackpot prize of P66.73 million. No bettor won the top prize.
